title: Membership in the initial-configuration language
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $x$ be a Boolean string, and let $c,s$ be natural numbers. The paired encoding of $x$ with the paired encodings of the binary expansions of $c$ and $s$ belongs to the initial-configuration language of $N$ if and only if the code, at window size $s$, of $N$'s initial configuration on input $x$ equals $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine N with Boolean input
